utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still only hearing bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m usually a bit late, but I can still help out. I’ll bring a few tools and check what’s left when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — that’d be really helpful. Let me know what’s still needed when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word on the street and check what tools I can bring. Send me the details whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send you the repair-drive details and a quick list of what’s needed, then I’ll note where you’d be most useful.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll look out for your message and jump in wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Noah — just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll bring whatever tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send the list as soon as I’ve got it. Appreciate you bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course, Noah — happy to help. Just send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’m still trying to remember my note, but I know I can help once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No rush — I’ll keep the repair drive in mind while you look, and I’ll let the neighbors know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. If I find my note, I’ll bring it right over; otherwise I’ll just come by and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira — I’m keeping track of the supplies, so if you hear what’s still missing, send it my way and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ve got the supplies list covered, right? If anything’s missing, I’ll send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ve got the supplies list covered, and I’ll note anything missing as soon as you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details now and start inviting a few more neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still running errands, but I’ll keep an eye out for the details and help after that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send them over soon and loop in a few more neighbors while you’re out. Thanks, Ira!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll spread the word and line up a few hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot — I’m going to check the parking lot first so I can unload without blocking anyone. If there’s still room after that, I’ll head over right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — check the lot first, and I’ll keep lining up a few helpers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — tell me what Hana needs, and I’ll help match the right folks to it. We’ve got good momentum on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’m checking the details first. Please match the folks who can bring tools and let me know who’s confirmed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll line up the folks who can bring tools and keep you posted on who’s confirmed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — glad you’re here. I’m organizing the repair drive list now, so just tell me what you can help with and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the porch light and check the gate too. If anything else comes to mind, let me know and I’ll help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Rey — thank you. I’ll note the porch light and gate, and I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if they’re short on anything specific. The lot’s probably the tricky part, so checking parking first sounds smart.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping an ear out — checking the parking first does sound like the right move.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem — I’ll tell you if they’re still looking for anything particular. Hope the parking works out, and you can swing by before the good stuff is gone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still waiting on the final details, but I can check with the organizers and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mina. That works for me—just let me know the time and place when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll check in and send you the time and place as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, 20 minutes after school works for me—just point me to where I should start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — start at the back gate, and I’ll meet you there with the flashlight and screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll head to the back gate and keep an eye out for you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details now and keep inviting a few more neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re really handling the details and inviting more neighbors, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, exactly — I’m on the details and I’ll keep inviting more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still running errands, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep people posted on what’s needed for the repair drive and circle back if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Vik — thanks for keeping me posted. I’ll check back in after my errands if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll keep the list simple and send over the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli. Just send me the time and place when you can, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Rey. I’ll send the time and place as soon as I have it all set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’ll double-check the plan before we start. Please bring the tools and tell me what still needs doing when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll bring the tools and check in on what still needs doing when I arrive at 9:00.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, 9:00 works — I’ll confirm the rest of the plan and be ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, please — I’d love the rundown on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — keep it quick and I’ll skim it. What’s left to do?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — just the main leftovers, please. I’m still catching bits and pieces, so a quick rundown would help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I’m hearing we still need a few volunteer shifts filled and a couple hands for sorting tools and materials. If you know anyone who wants to jump in, I can connect them to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with sorting tools and materials, and I’ll bring a few of my own too. I may be a little late, but I’ll check what’s still left when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Dane — I’ll put you down for sorting tools and materials, and your extra supplies will really help. If you’re running late, just swing by and I’ll point you to what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still in, I just need the time and place. Once you send it, I can help sort donations and carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll check the lot and send you the time and place as soon as I’ve got it. If parking looks tight, I may ask you to come a little later so we don’t block anyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just send me the time and place, and if parking’s tight, I can come a little later.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo — I’m keeping track of the helpers and what each person is bringing, so I can match everyone to the right spot. Tell me what needs attention first, and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — the first thing is getting the donations sorted and the box-moving covered. I’ll spread the word and send you the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll note donations sorting and box-moving as the first priorities. Send me the time and place when you have it, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please send the details. I’d appreciate it if you invite a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send the details and invite a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can do that — I’ll ask around and see what they still need most. If you get there soon, you might still catch the better tools before they’re gone.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — that’d be really helpful. I’m heading over soon, so I’ll try to catch the better tools while they’re still there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep asking around and let you know if they’re still short on anything in particular. Hope you get there before the good tools disappear!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still trying to remember if there was one more thing on the list. I know the porch light and loose gate, but I may need to check my note before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Oren — check your note and I’ll keep track of the supplies once you’ve got the full list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll take a quick look for my note, and if I can’t find it, I’ll just help with the porch light and gate for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I’m happy to bring my tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need and when to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — could you be there at 9:00 a.m.? Your tools will be a big help, and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Mara — I’ll be there at 9:00 a.m. with my tools. Glad to help with the repair drive.
